shortDescription: Manage packages with apk on OpenWrt

options.name: allow_untrusted
options.description: To install a locally available apk package, for example if this device has no internet access but you can upload apk packages directly to it.

options.name: force_broken_world
options.description: Continue even if package dependencies are broken.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the package(s) to install or remove. Multiple packages can be specified as a comma-separated list with no spaces, for example V(curl,wget).

options.name: no_cache
options.description: Do not use a local cache files, fetch from index directly. Mutually exclusive with (O(update_cache)).

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the package should be installed or removed.

options.name: update_cache
options.description: Update the package cache (C(apk update)) before performing the operation. Mutually exclusive with (O(no_cache)).
